item.title: Happy Birthday RECOVER !!!
item.description: RECOVER is the research unit I am working in, and it recently celebrated its tenth birthday. This provided an opportunity to illustrate its research activities by creating the RECOVER soundtrack.

item.title: Drought and Fire Conditions in France, 1959-2099
item.description: In France, year 2022 witnessed severe drought conditions, leading to very low flows in rivers starting in the spring and widespread wildfire occurrences in summer.
